subject: ventures/chant-forge
professional: a Gregorian schola director who engraves square notation (Gregorio/GABC, Vatican 1908 Graduale), with an OMR engineer for the scan reader and a mastering engineer for the loudness checks. The schola director checks first that every GABC pitch lands on the right step under every clef and that only what is sung gets sung; the OMR engineer checks the reader on pages he drew himself and whether the agreement metric is a fair one; the mastering engineer checks LUFS/true peak against a second meter

evidence.correctness: Five independent recomputations, all right. (1) pitchToMidi for every clef c1-c4, f1-f4 with and without the flat clef, all 13 letters a-m (208 cases) against my own Python derivation (line n on letter 2n+1; C clef marks do, F clef fa): 208/208 identical (node pm.mjs vs python pm.py, diff empty). (2) A real F-clef file, corpus/gregobase-1908-checked/3606.gabc (f3, Ego autem, mode 2): node cli.mjs ... -o f.mid, read back with my own raw-byte SMF parser: first 12 notes 62 60 64 62 62 60 62 65 65 65 67 65 at 240-tick pulses, which is f v//e g f | f | e f h h h i h by hand under f3 (h = fa = F4); final D4 = re, correct for mode 2; tempo 500000 us = 120 BPM. (3) A fresh EDM render with the sung choir (render-cli --sing) of that piece: master-cli -18.9 LUFS, -1.48 dBTP, LRA 1.0 LU; ffmpeg 6.1 ebur128=peak=true: I -18.9 LUFS, LRA 1.0 LU, peak -1.5 dBFS. (4) Spotify gain +0.48 dB by hand: target -14 asks +4.9 dB, capped at -1 dBTP from -1.48 dBTP. (5) scan.mjs align() distance against my own Sellers (1980) semi-global DP on 300 random sequence pairs: 0 mismatches. Partial: on pages I drew myself (python synth.py, square heads at known positions, C clef on line 3 or 4), readPage reads 20 of 20 heads at the right step when a head clears the staff lines by 4 px or more, but a head in a space that clears a line by 1-3 px, or that is over 0.85 spaces tall, is read twice (26 notes for 20, 40 for 20), because binarize fills any vertical white gap of up to 3 px (scan.mjs:74) and the head then merges with both lines into a run that is split in two. On the project's real 1908 scans this does not bite (its agreement figures are measured), so the score stays 3.
evidence.completeness: Re-ran the README's main 'works now' items: GABC to MIDI on c and f clefs (real F-clef file above), --genre edm, --auto-final, --cues (cue sheet written), render-cli --sing (39 s rendered in 1.0 s), master-cli (FAIL/PASS lines, LRA, per-service gain), eval/batch-check.mjs (60 files, 50 on the mode final, 0 warnings), eval/offfinal-report.mjs (10 off-final files, all marked read against the book), the scan reader on drawn pages, and the clef-bridge change of PR #17527 (clef-bridge.test.mjs passes; eval/clef-bridge-tuning-report.md:24 has the 24,479 -> 24,538 the README states). Served copy (node platform/pages/served-copy.mjs chant-forge): no placeholder origin left. Not run: the Playwright studio check and the archive.org page downloads (the scan agreement numbers rest on the author's runs and committed reports). The README is candid that no voice is a release voice and nothing has been heard by a person.
evidence.verification: node --test '*.test.mjs' in ventures/chant-forge: 331 tests, 331 pass, 0 fail, 55.7 s (was 83 at the 2026-11-08 audit). Four mutations through platform/ci/quality_mutate.py: the BS.1770 relative gate -10 -> -20 LU (the defect of the last audit) is now CAUGHT by master/ebu tests; CLEF_BRIDGE 0.15 -> 0 CAUGHT (clef-bridge.test.mjs); the F-clef offset lineIdx - 3 -> - 4 in gabc.mjs CAUGHT (2 tests); the binarize gap fill <= 4 -> <= 3 in scan.mjs SURVIVED (no test pins the fleck fill, the constant behind the double-read above). Three of four caught, including both core paths a schola director and a mastering engineer care about.
evidence.craft: Read gabc.mjs (318 lines), scan.mjs readStaff/findClef/readPage/align/binarize, master.mjs integratedLufs, clef-bridge.test.mjs. Still zero dependencies, browser-safe, deterministic, with opt-out flags for every reader change so before/after can be compared. Defects: scan.mjs is now 1,155 lines of accreted per-edition heuristics with about a dozen tuned constants and option flags (FLECK, STROKE_TOP_FALL, BROKEN_STROKE, ONE_STEP, CLEF_BRIDGE ...); the gap fill in binarize is a fixed 3 px rather than a fraction of the staff space, so the reader's behaviour depends on scan resolution (shown on drawn pages); gabc.mjs:192 still skips unknown characters silently (defect of the last audit, still present); the README is a 2,961-line, 230 KB lab notebook in which a user cannot find what is current, and it contradicts itself (README.md:2425 'not yet run on a batch of GregoBase files' vs README.md:2914).
evidence.claims: Checked: llms.txt now matches the repository on its main points (GABC to MIDI, genre templates, preview synth, loudness and release checks, scan reader, nothing sung or released): the llms.txt defect of the last audit is fixed except one count, llms.txt:31 'Run on 64 real GregoBase files' (the corpus now holds 139 GregoBase downloads in seven gregobase-1908* folders plus the top-level pieces). README.md:153 still says chant-forge.test.mjs has 8 tests (14 now; defect of the last audit, still present). README.md:2919 '11 of the 59 end off the mode final' is stale: eval/batch-check.mjs prints 60 files, 50 on the final, and eval/offfinal-report.mjs 10 off-final. index.html:133 now carries a no-warranty, not-legal-advice disclaimer and says no choir performs it (last audit's defect fixed); usage counting is the site chrome's beacon (platform/pages/counter-wiring.test.mjs), not per page. The clef-bridge numbers in README.md:2902 match eval/clef-bridge-tuning-report.md:24; the ffmpeg agreement and EBU claims reproduce on my own render. All stale figures understate the work; none overclaims, so 3.
evidence.fitness: The producer's job (chant line into a DAW, a backing, a checked master, a release folder) runs end to end from one GABC file in seconds, and the F-clef fix means more Graduale pieces check cleanly. Where a producer or schola director stalls: the only voice is a preview formant synth that no person has listened to; rhythm is a flat pulse grid; and for the 32 corpus files that carry an introit's psalm-tone cue, the track ends with the choir singing the letters 'E u o u a e' (node cli.mjs corpus/gregobase-1908/3402.gabc --cues: syllables o, u, a, e on the last notes) after a bare 'Gloria Patri' cue, instead of the doxology and the antiphon repeat. No audio a human has judged, so 2.
evidence.domain: Against Gregorio GABC semantics and Vatican 1908 practice the pitch layer is right (208/208 clef cases, accidentals reset at word or bar, custodes not sung, bivirga/tristropha as printed). Departures a schola director flags: 'Euouae' is a placeholder for the vowels of 'saeculorum. Amen' and is never sung as letters, and 'Gloria Patri' in an introit file is a cue for the full doxology followed by the antiphon da capo; gabc.mjs sings both literally (32 corpus files), and the off-final introits end off the final for exactly that reason. The four mode-2 graduals/alleluias/offertories ending on A (3426, 3429, 3434, 3451) are the transposed second mode (the Iustus ut palma family, final on the affinal la), not a psalm-tone differentia as README.md:2919-2920 implies. Neume nuance (quilisma lengthening the preceding note, liquescents, salicus) is flattened. The OMR reader is honest that it does not read clef type, accidentals or text and that it is tuned on Vatican printing only; its agreement figures are measured against the same GregoBase transcriptions it was tuned on, with held-out leaf lists registered before download.

verdict: Re-audit after eleven days of heavy work (83 -> 331 tests, a scan reader, sung preview, release folder, F-clef bridge in PR #17527). Earlier defects: the untested BS.1770 relative gate is fixed (the -10 -> -20 LU mutant is now caught), llms.txt is rewritten and current except one count (llms.txt:31), the studio page now has a disclaimer (index.html:133), and the post-1929 Te Deum was replaced by the 1908 one with the remaining 1961/1974 transcriptions read by eye against pre-1929 books; still present are README.md:153 '8 tests' and the silent skip of unknown GABC characters (gabc.mjs:192). Every output I recomputed matched: 208/208 clef-letter pitches against my own derivation, a real F-clef piece note by note from raw MIDI bytes, loudness, LRA and true peak against ffmpeg on a fresh sung render, Spotify's capped gain by hand, and the scan aligner against an independent Sellers DP. It meets the bar on correctness, claims and verification. Below the bar: domain and fitness, because an introit's 'Gloria Patri ... E u o u a e' cue is sung as letters in 32 corpus files, rhythm and neume nuance are flat, no person has heard any of it, and the OMR reader double-reads heads that sit a few pixels off the lines because its gap fill is a fixed 3 px.
